description: This file defines the NamedExampleStorageFactory class that implements INamedExampleStorageFactory interface. It provides a method to create storage instances based on a name and configuration, utilizing dependency injection to retrieve the appropriate storage factory.

classes.name: NamedExampleStorageFactory
